**Chi-Kuang Yeh**\
*Department of Mathematics and Statistics*\
*Georgia State University*

## Description

This is the repo for the source code of Chi-Kuang Yeh's personal website.

For my professional webpage, see [my GSU page](https://cas.gsu.edu/profile/chi-kuang-yeh/). My main appointment is in the Department of Mathematics and Statistics, and I am also affiliated with the Neuroscience Institute, and the cosmic group in the Department of Physics and Astronomy. 

My research interests include functional data analysis, optimal design of experiment, statistical machine learning and high-dimensional statistics, with applications span on neuroscience, drug development and toxicology.
